phases.objective: Deliver one synthetic-runtime Admin or Tenant request that resolves authority, persists an immutable plan, dispatches through the certified worker, and returns exact readback and reconciliation evidence.
blockers: Durable SQL persistence and mounted repositories are not implemented.
Admin and Tenant runtime routes are not mounted through Context Kernel and Effective Authority.
The managed worker, pinned Hostinger host key, approved binary digests, and target-bound tool discovery are not certified.
Recovery checkpoint, restore verification, attestation, and replica verification are not yet integrated into the execution authorization bundle.
Consequential filesystem mutation lacks a race-resistant low-level executor.
Unknown-outcome reconciliation is not proven across a real worker restart.
The current phase has no mounted synthetic-runtime E2E journey.

planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The exact operation is read back as succeeded, partially applied, held, or reconciled with durable per-item evidence and no cross-tenant leakage.
steps: Resolve Tenant, Workspace, Resource, ownership, and effective authority.
Load the immutable plan, approval set, execution lease, toolchain resolution, checkpoint, and signed attestation.
Dispatch one fixed worker operation without free-form shell input.
Persist per-item prepared and result journal records.
Read back provider and filesystem evidence.
Reconcile unknown or partial outcomes and project Tenant-safe evidence.

phases.objective: Preserve the MVP journey while adding cancellation, lease release, approval revocation, bounded retries, and operator-visible state transitions.
Prove fault injection, worker restart recovery, unknown-outcome reconciliation, checkpoint restoration, and inode-exhaustion reserve release.
Run the same journey against one allowlisted non-production Tenant root, then a governed shared/platform target with impact-set approvals.
Enable read-only Production preflight first, then require exact Production SHA and runtime readback before any separately governed mutation capability.

workstreams.title: Spec and contract correction
deliverables: Corrected Spec Kit, OpenAPI, schemas, data model, threat model, phase contract, and completion governance

workstreams.title: Durable control plane
deliverables: Canonical full-plan envelope and unified execution authorization bundle
Repository-bound approval set, tool provenance, recovery and attestation bindings
Transactional repository contract with operation idempotency, immutable plans, CAS leases, append-only journals, plan consumption, and reconciliation

workstreams.title: Read-only Hostinger adapter
deliverables: Pinned read-only discovery, scan, quota evidence, layout inventory, and audience-safe projections without apply

workstreams.title: Recovery and attestation
deliverables: Recovery checkpoint, restore verification, replica verification, signed attestation, policy parity, and telemetry contracts

workstreams.title: Synthetic mutation executor
deliverables: Race-resistant low-level executor, crash-safe per-item journal, fault injection, unknown-outcome drill, and inode-exhaustion reserve release

workstreams.title: Tenant-exclusive canary
deliverables: One allowlisted non-production Tenant root with Workspace Owner approval, full readback, recovery proof, and manual enablement

workstreams.title: Platform and shared canary
deliverables: Impact-set approvals, Release Authority, reserve certification, and shared deployment-layout proof

workstreams.title: Production preflight
deliverables: Read-only Production pressure gate, exact Production SHA/runtime verification, and no automatic cleanup
